articles.summary: DALLAS, TX, Jan. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Strive, Inc. (Nasdaq: ASST) (“Strive”) today announced the successful completion of the previously announced acquisition of Semler Scientific. Strive now holds approximately 12,797.9 bitcoin, becoming the #11 largest public corporate holder of bitcoin globally.
